results.title: Disable direct SSH root login
results.remediation: Set PermitRootLogin no in the SSH server configuration and reload SSH after validating access.

results.title: Disable SSH password authentication
results.remediation: Use SSH keys, set PasswordAuthentication no, and reload SSH after confirming key-based access works.

results.title: Limit SSH MaxAuthTries to 4 or lower
results.remediation: Set MaxAuthTries 4 or lower in the SSH server configuration and reload SSH.

results.title: Disable SSH X11 forwarding
results.remediation: Set X11Forwarding no in the SSH server configuration and reload SSH.

results.title: Configure SSH idle timeout
results.remediation: Configure ClientAliveInterval with a non-zero value to reduce unattended SSH sessions.

results.title: Host firewall is active
results.remediation: Allow required management access first, then enable and verify the host firewall.

results.title: /etc/shadow permissions are 640 or stricter
results.remediation: Review ownership and permissions on /etc/shadow and restrict them to 640 or stricter.

results.title: /etc/passwd permissions are 644 or stricter
results.remediation: Review ownership and permissions on /etc/passwd and restrict them to 644 or stricter.

results.title: No local accounts have an empty password field
results.remediation: Lock or assign strong credentials to any account with an empty password field.

results.title: Only root has UID 0
results.remediation: Remove UID 0 from non-root accounts unless there is a documented and approved exception.

results.title: Minimum password length is 14 or more
results.remediation: Configure a minimum password length of at least 14 in the active password quality policy.
results.notes: Required security configuration is not explicitly configured.
results.raw_evidence: No explicit minimum password length detected

results.title: Audit service is active
results.remediation: Install auditd if needed, enable it, and start the audit service.

results.title: Automatic security updates are enabled
results.remediation: Enable unattended security updates and verify the automatic update configuration.

results.title: Time synchronization is active
results.remediation: Enable and verify system time synchronization using systemd-timesyncd, chrony, or another approved time service.

results.title: Telnet server is not installed
results.remediation: Remove the Telnet server package and use SSH for secure remote administration.
